channel.title: Oceanfront Property Hunt
channel.desc: Erica and Heather are both maritime girls with a deep connection to Nova Scotia and a dream of living by the water. Heather wants a place to relax and recover from ongoing health challenges, while Erica is looking for a home with projects to tackle. With a tight budget and big dreams, can they find the perfect place to call home?
